rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: On 19 September 2005 the national president of the PT, Tarso Genro, and the national PED coordinator, Francisco Campos, released at a press conference the first partial bulletin of the vote for the national presidency.

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The first partial bulletin (115,317 votes counted by 12h on 19 September 2005) puts Ricardo Berzoini first with 41.6%, followed by Valter Pomar, Plínio de Arruda Sampaio, Maria do Rosário and Raul Pont, and says a second round is practically certain.
